general.heading: General Settings
general.author: Author
general.languageHint: Changes the language of the editor interface.
general.autoArrangeDesc: Automatically spread characters apart when they share the same stage position (e.g. two characters both set to "Center" will appear side-by-side). Characters are kept within view.
general.defaultGameSettingsDesc: These values are used as the initial settings when a player starts your game.
general.enableSkipDesc: Allow players to skip through text quickly
general.autoAdvanceDesc: Automatically proceed to next dialogue line

fonts.heading: Font Settings
fonts.empty: No custom fonts uploaded yet. Upload a .ttf or .otf file to make it available in all font pickers throughout your project.
fonts.note: Font settings for dialogue text, name box, choice buttons, and input boxes are configured in the In-Game UI editor. Select an element there to edit its font properties.

screens.heading: Special Screens
screens.intro: Assign UI screens you've built in the Menu Editor to serve as your game's system menus. Each slot controls when and where a screen appears during gameplay.
screens.noScreensDesc: Create screens in the Menu Editor tab first, then return here to assign them. The Menu Editor lets you visually design title screens, settings menus, save/load screens, and more.

slots.titleScreenDesc: Shown when the game first launches. Typically contains New Game, Continue, Settings, and Quit buttons.
slots.settingsScreenDesc: In-game settings menu where players adjust text speed, volume, and other preferences.
slots.saveScreenDesc: Screen shown when the player saves their progress. Displays available save slots.
slots.loadScreenDesc: Screen shown when the player loads a previous save. Can share a layout with the Save Screen.
slots.pauseScreenDesc: Shown when the player presses Escape during gameplay. Usually offers Resume, Save, Load, Settings, and Quit.
slots.gameHudDesc: Persistent overlay displayed on top of gameplay, e.g. custom button bars, status indicators, or affection meters.

cgGallery.heading: CG Gallery
cgGallery.intro: Manage the CG (Computer Graphics) gallery entries that players can unlock and view. Add images from your project assets and optionally tie them to boolean variables to create unlockable gallery items.
cgGallery.noEntriesHint: Click "Add Entry" to create your first CG gallery item
cgGallery.name: Name
cgGallery.noBooleanVars: No boolean variables found. Create a boolean variable in the Variables panel to use as an unlock trigger.

musicGallery.heading: Music Gallery
musicGallery.intro: Manage the songs players can unlock and listen to in a Music Gallery player. Pick music files from your project's audio, give each song a cover picture, and optionally lock songs behind an unlock switch that your story flips on.
musicGallery.defaultArtwork: Cover picture for songs without their own
musicGallery.defaultArtworkHint: Used while a song plays if that song has no cover picture of its own.
musicGallery.noSongsHint: Click "Add Song" to add your first song — or use the Music Gallery wizard on a screen to set everything up at once
musicGallery.noAudioAssets: No audio files found. Add music in the Assets tab first.
musicGallery.createUnlockHint: Makes a new on/off switch for this song that stays flipped across playthroughs. Turn it on in your story with a Set Variable command.

accessibility.heading: Accessibility Settings
accessibility.intro: These settings affect the editor interface only, not your exported game. Settings are saved to your browser and persist across sessions.

items.highContrastDesc: Increases border thickness and contrast throughout the editor UI for better visibility.
items.reducedMotionDesc: Disables all CSS animations and transitions. Recommended for motion-sensitive users.
items.largeTextDesc: Scales up all editor text by 20% for improved readability on high-DPI screens.
items.keyboardOnlyDesc: Always shows prominent focus outlines on interactive elements. Automatically activates when Tab is pressed.
items.screenReaderModeDesc: Adds ARIA landmarks and labels for better screen reader navigation. Enable if using NVDA, JAWS, or VoiceOver.

analytics.heading: Session Analytics
analytics.intro: Tracks your editing activity during this session. Data is stored in memory and resets when you close the editor.
analytics.noActions: No actions tracked yet. Start editing your project to see analytics here.
analytics.patternsDesc: Action sequences you perform frequently — consider templates or shortcuts for these.
